title: openrouter.decisions.request.v1
description: Verified wire format for POST https://openrouter.ai/api/alpha/decisions, per docs/PI/pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 1 (empirically verified against the live endpoint with the existing JEV_OPENROUTER_API_KEY, 2026-09-22). This is the ACTUAL integration path for this project -- not the standard chat/completions endpoint, and not TypeSafe's own api.typesafe.ai (that direct API exists but is not used here). decisionsService.ts (M3) constructs this FROM pi.decisions.request.v1.

model.description: OpenRouter vendor/model id for the decisions model, e.g. "typesafe/jev-1.13". Confirmed valid; jev-1.13.0 / jev-latest / jev-preview (the TypeSafe-direct alias scheme) were tried and rejected with "is not a valid model ID" -- do not reuse those on this endpoint.

state.description: Content to evaluate. In this project: the allowlist projection carried in pi.decisions.request.v1.state_projection.

question.description: Only the choice shape was empirically exercised against this endpoint; noul/score are carried over from the underlying TypeSafe primitive contract (docs.typesafe.ai/api.md) and still need a live test before production use (pi_jev_m0_provider_protocol_de.md section 6).
